title: ConfigUpgradeSet holding CONFIG_SETTING_FREEZE_BYPASS_TXS_DELTA, the upgrade-set bytes stellar-core stores in contract data
why: From protocol 26 the list of transactions allowed to bypass frozen keys (CAP-0077) changes through a delta: hashes to add and hashes to remove. stellar-core applies the delta to the stored CONFIG_SETTING_FREEZE_BYPASS_TXS entry and never stores the delta, so the only place a ledger holds this arm is the ConfigUpgradeSet kept as SCV_BYTES contract data before the upgrade. Readers that decode those bytes and know only the stored setting arms reject them.

source.reason: a delta setting is an upgrade instruction that stellar-core applies to the stored setting and never stores itself, so a ledger holds it only inside a ConfigUpgradeSet kept as SCV_BYTES contract data; these are the exact upgrade-set bytes scenario s21-rare-scval-arms uploaded (identical under both passphrases), as an entry of their own

notes: The bytes are copied from the scenario's chain, where they sit inside contract data; coverage counts the arm there only as upgrade-set bytes, and this entry gives readers the value itself.
